title: Read a labelled input
summary: IonInput can manage a typed value with React state.
introduction: IonInput can manage a typed value with React state. Your task: Type a name and then erase it.
learningObjectives: Type a name and then erase it.
Explain the example for read a labelled input

blocks.text: IonInput can manage a typed value with React state. onIonInput provides the latest text through event.detail.value.
Use an Ionic React starter with its setupIonicReact call and standard Ionic CSS imports. Put these components in App.tsx or App.jsx. The plain playground does not load Ionic styles or components.

blocks.title: Read a labelled input

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `onIonInput` supplies current Ionic input text through `event.detail.value`.
`useState` gives React a remembered value and a setter. Call the setter to ask React to show the next value.
`IonContent` owns the Ionic screen's scrolling content area. It works inside the starter app's page structure.

blocks.text: The greeting follows the typed name.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use the Ionic event detail, not an assumed native input target. Keep a label that stays visible.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Type a name and then erase it.
